gencode.candidate_definition: unique gene_id + chromosome + strand + exact 0-based TSS point derived from transcript records

coordinate_rule: GENCODE transcript TSS converted from 1-based GTF to 0-based point; SCREEN BED interpreted as 0-based half-open. Candidate is annotated PLS-supported if TSS point lies within at least one PLS interval.
interpretation: SCREEN PLS overlap is promoter-like regulatory evidence on the annotation-defined candidate universe. It is not a candidate-existence criterion and must not be used to drop the 210,502 candidates lacking PLS overlap.
